title: A must do and Yes we got to jump the queue
text:
Excellent Must Do
0830 start. Yes we got to jump the queue. Guided tour with headphones. Maria R was very informative explaining the history and art of the buildings and gardens.
author: Jella K

title: Early access with Alba
text: Alba was a great guide. She was very organised  and super knowledgable about the Alcazar.  Due to the storm the garden was closed but as a group we had lots of time to see the building's interior. The early start was worthwhile to avoid the crowds.
author: jennyrF1879VM

title: Incredible Tour of the Alcazar!!
text: Alba was amazing! She was extremely friendly, knowledgeable and passionate! You can tell she genuinely loves history and so many great insights to share. Highly recommend the early entry tour of the palace to give yourself time and space to see the palace and all the intricate detail and take pictures without hundreds of other people!
author: r2rospert

title: Take the early visit
text: Unfortunately it was wet so we could not see the garden. Great to go early and have the place to ourselves. Alba was brilliant and made the tour extra good.
author: 852prof

title: Great before hours tour
text: Alba was the best guide, gave a lot of historical & fun facts
author: M4432IJenriquec

title: Great tour of palace
text: The palace was sold out the day we went.  But we were able to purchase tickets for this private tour.  Tour guide was wonderful.  It was raining, so it was a perfect morning to spend at the palace.
author: jackiesJ8430MV

title: Good tour with no crowds
text: Very informative tour. Raquel was an interesting guide. It was great to be in the Alcazar with no crowds.
author: MountainMike7

title: Great guide and early small group tour.
text: Great early tour of the Alcázar! Small group, informative guide, amazing to see the rooms without the crowds, and have the historical background too! Raquel was a fabulous knowledgeable guide who is passionate about Seville and its history.
